description: Daisy-chained switch SW-EDGE-02 only. For Discover use site_both_switches.json, which also lists SW-CORE-01's devices. Laptop 192.168.1.240 (wired) -> test switch NETTEST Gi1/0/24; test switch Gi1/0/23 -> PP-Z:23 = PP-A:23 -> SW-CORE-01 Gi1/0/23; SW-CORE-01 Gi1/0/24 -> SW-EDGE-02 Gi1/0/1 (copper daisy chain). Test switch settings are in test_switch, the production switches' read-only logins (for the Switch Port Audit) in switches. Passwords are never saved.

connections.notes: Copper uplink back to the production switch; ip is SW-CORE-01's management address. All test traffic to SW-EDGE-02 arrives through this link.
